notes.title: Update 78
notes.content:
My Lords and Ladies, our march to greatness continues with [b]Update 78[/b]!

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]

1. Paragon system reworked - welcome to the new Paragon system, featuring new cluster progression mechanics, Ability modifiers and Special Perks. This brand new system will be unlocked during the second half of March 2025. Stay tuned for more news soon!

2. Fast-Paced Realm Invasion event – this new fast–paced format of the traditional Realm Invasion (RvR) event includes:
- 4h Preparation Phase
- 8h Invasion Phase
- Pillage Time 15 min (instead of 60 min)
- Recovery Time 15 min (instead of 30 min)
- Fortifications done during the Preparation Phase are more expensive, but have a boosted effect
- Stronger Invasion Backing (Realm buff) during the Invasion Phase
- Post-Invasion Backing (Realm Buff) is boosted and has a 24h duration

[b][BALANCE CHANGES AND QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS][/b]
1. Steel has been added to the resources HUD
2. Added the option to sell multiple equipment items at once
3. Maximum Champion XP gain capacity has been increased from 2 million to 3.25 million
4. Many time-limited events have been permanently buffed with better Milestone Rewards, Leaderboard Rewards and additional Leaderboard brackets

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]
1. World Encounters Theme Rotation – the Ronins are about to invade our Realms! It’s up to you to smash their camps and retrieve the treasures they have stolen!
2. New Path to Glory

[b][BUG FIXES][/b]
- Fixed an issue where Gemstones could be added over the selection limit using the Max button when crafting Tier IX Gemstones
- Fixed the craft multiple Gems max button
- Fixed the background of the Pure Meat and the Wonder Roots in their respective chests preview shown as gray
- Fixed voting percentage for "Yes" always showing 60%

notes.title: Update 77
notes.content:
My Lords and Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 77! This update brings to the Realms of March of Empires some long awaited feature extensions, balance changes and quality of life improvements.

[b][FESTIVE CONTENT][/b]
1. Christmas Event Shop (23 – 30 December) – participate in time-limited events to gain event shop currency and use it to acquire the items you desire!
2. Festive Village Event - join forces with all the rulers in your Realm to build the most magnificent Festive Village! Upgrade your Village to spawn more crates and collect them for festive rewards!

[b][FEATURE EXTENSIONS][/b]
1. 18x new Scepter equipment items have been added (unlocks on Update)
2. 23x new Trinket equipment items have been added (unlocks on Update)
3. World Encounter Camps level 13, 14, 15 have been added (to be unlocked on 3 January 2025)
4. Menagerie building and Animal Companions extension (to be unlocked on 10 December 2024): 
   - Menagerie building max level is now 47 (increased from 42). Each new level unlocks a new perk
   - Animal Companions max level is now 30 (increased from 25). Some Animals unlock a new powerful trait at level 26
   - Two new legendary Foods have been added to upgrade your Animal Companions beyond level 25: Pure Meat and Wonder Roots
5. New Campaign Chapter with new missions to complete and new prizes to be earned (to be unlocked on 3 January 2025)

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]
1. World Encounters theme rotation: Brigands are invading the Realms! March against their camps to retrieve the treasures they have stolen! (to be unlocked on 3 January 2025)
2. New Path to Glory Chapter with new missions to complete and new prizes to be earned

[b][QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS][/b]
1. You can now craft multiple Gems at once (unlock on Update)
2. Enjoy new and improved Alliance Shop items (unlocks on Update)

[b][BALANCE CHANGES][/b]
*All changes listed below will be applied on Update
1. Throne of Might bonuses and Seats of Power bonuses
   - Throne of Might (Emperor’s bonuses)
   - Bonus Attack & Health increased from 150% to 300%
   - Gather speed bonus increased from 50% to 100%
   - Seats of Power - Stacking bonus (Attack & Health) increased from 5% to 20%
   - Seat of War - Bonus Attack & Health changed from 75% to 200% (400% if policy selected)
   - Seat of Order - Bonus All Income changed from 250% to 500% (1,000% if policy selected)
   - Seat of Domain - Bonus March Speed changed from 50% to 100% (200% if policy selected)
   - Seat of Accord - no changes
   - Seat of Heroes - bonus Faction Train Speed changed from 50% to 100% (200% if policy selected)

2. World Policies
   - Deadly Traps - bonus Defenses Attack increased from 200% to 500%
   - Production Focus - Bonus All Income increased from 250% to 500%
   - Conscription - bonus Train Speed increased from 125% to 250%
   - Research Focus - bonus Research Speed increased from 50% to 150%. Cost multiplier decreased from 100% to 10%
   - Construction Focus - bonus Construction Speed increased from 33% to 150%. Cost multiplier decreased from 50% to 10%
   - Exploit Resources - bonus Gathering Speed increased from 35% to 100%
   - Realm Patrol - bonus Army Health vs. PvE increased from 75% to 200%
   - Seasonal Preparations - weather bonuses increased from 5x to 10x
   - Free Trade - Silver collected reduction changed from 50% to 15%
   - Regional Investments - Effects increased from 2x to 3x
   - Alliance Logistics - Additional marches increased from 1 to 2
   - Adventuring Champions - bonus Rewards increased from 300% to 500%
   - Legendary Training - Faction Units Train Speed increased from 50% to 250%

3. Decrees
   - Throne of Might attackers attack reduction changed from -30% to -400%
   - Grand Campaign - bonus healing speed increased from 15% to 40%
   - Purge the Realm - increased time between attacks reduction from 20% to 25%
   - Trade Levy Lifted - trade march size bonus increased from 75% to 200%
   - For the Realm - bonus for fighting invaders increased from 40% to 400%
   - Redistribute Wealth - gathering speed bonus increased from 20% to 100%

4. Court Advisors
   - Guardian - March size vs. PvE changed from 10% to 30%
   - Marshal - bonus Trap Repair (re-arm) time decrease changed from 30% to 200%
   - Archaeologist - bonus Gathering speed provided increased from 20% to 50%
   - Fool - bonus Attack & Health provided changed from -100% to -300%

5. World Encounters and Barbarian Hordes strength has been rebalanced for “old” and “merged” Realms

6. All Realm Age Banners bonuses have been greatly increased

notes.title: Update 76
notes.content:
Lords & Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 76!

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]

• Battleground – new time-limited Alliance event that will be unlocked during the second half of November 2024. In this event you’ll travel with your allies to a new world map and fight for territorial conquest against enemy Alliances. Communication and coordination are the keys to success in this highly strategic game mode, featuring massive battles, tile-based movement, unique skills and buffs, terrain logistics and much more! Stay tuned for more news on Social Media and in your in-game Global News section.

• Tier VII Army Units – they are not here to take part, they are here to take over!  We’re marching closer to a new era of elite warriors that will begin in December 2024! You’ll be able to train and raise T7 units after the arrival of Castle level 37 and Era VIII of Academy Researches (see section “EXTENSIONS”)

• Supremus – let’s welcome the first of its kind unique personal Champion. This mighty gladiator belongs to no Faction and convincing him to march for you will be no easy task. To earn his respect you must first prove yourself in the Gladiator Arena. Each Realm will have 3 special editions of the Gladiator Arena event during which you can win a Supremus’ Scroll and unlock Supremus as your new personal Champion. Unique Champions have different Almanac tasks for each Faction. Completing them will permanently boost your Faction bonuses. 

Supremus Gladiator Arena events:
- 15 November 2024
- 20 November 2024
- 22 November 2024

[b][EXTENSIONS][/b]

• Castle level 37 – become stronger than ever by upgrading your Castle buildings to level 37. This Castle extension will be unlocked in mid December 2024. It comes with a new ERA VIII of Academy Researches. There you will find the knowledge needed to unlock Tier VII Army Units and many other powerful perks!

[b][HOLIDAY CONTENT][/b]

• Halloween Event Shop – participate in time-limited events to gain Event Shop currency and use it to acquire the items you desire. The Halloween Event Shop will be open between: 31 October – 9 November

• Halloween Lottery – 31 October 2024 

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]

• World Encounters Theme Rotation – the Headless Knights are invading the Realms! March against their Nightmare Camps to retrieve the treasures they have stolen!

• New Path to Glory

[b][BALANCE CHANGES][/b]

• Unit Types marching speed is now equalized for all Unit Tiers (f.e. T1 Cavalry march speed = T6 Cavalry March Speed)

[b][BUG FIXES][/b]

• Poacher camps getting stuck after you lose a battle against them
• Poacher camps pop-up gets corrupted when you lose a battle against them and attack again
• Instant completing adventures with gold doesn't count progress for the Midas event

notes.title: Update 72
notes.content:
Lords & Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 72. This time we have prepared for you a brand new Historical Story Mission that follows the life of the Norwegian king Harald Hardrada, a new Mercenary Faction Unit, new Paragon Skill for the Assist Trait Animal Companions, an extension of the Gemstones feature, a long list of balance changes and quality of life improvement and more!

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]

- New Historical Story Mission: “The Last Real Viking” – follow the steps of King Harald Hardrada from Norway. Take charge of his amazing life story starting when he was only 15 years old during the Battle of Stiklestad, all the way up to his demise in 1066 during the Battle of Stamford Bridge. Many modern historians refer to Harald’s death as “the end of the Viking Age”

- New Mercenary Faction Unit: Carthaginian War Elephant – this brand new Army Unit classifies as both Mercenary and Faction unit (just like the first unit of this type – the Kheshig). The Carthaginian War Elephant takes 65% less damage from enemy attacks and has an area of effect attack that can push back enemies. Having this unit in your Army Formation will also reduce the enemy player’s Army Defense by 5%

- New Paragon Skill: “Instant Hunt” – only available during the Age of Excellence. When activated this Paragon Skill allows you to perform the next 3 animal hunts instantaneously without reducing the hunting tile’s potency

- Gemstones extension – following the release of Update 72 the maximum level of Gemstones will be raised to level 9. Upgrading your Gems beyond level 8 will require a new resource called “Jeweler’s Chisels”

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]

- Age of Excellence – shortly after the release of Update 72 we will march into the Age of Excellence. This age comes with a new set of Realm buffs and conditions like: 3 extra Mercenary squads can be added in Army Formations / all Paragon Points gains are increased by 5% and others

- World Encounters theme rotation – Ronins are about to invade the Realms! Get ready to smash their camps and retrieve the treasures they have stolen

[b][QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS][/b]

- Added a new interface menu that allows you to automate your animal assists

- New hunting march animation added

[b][BALANCE CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS][/b]

- Holy Site Regional Building – the Army Attack Boost will now provide Army Health as well. In addition, the Holy Site can now provide 2 new boosts: Champion XP and March Size VS Encounters

- All Regional Focuses except Mobilization have been greatly improved

- Alliance Mine Raid is getting buffed with decreased starting Keys cost of 750 (instead of 1000), increased resource cap for all resource types, 4 free marches (instead of 2) and Gathered Resource Bonus can be bought 5 more times

- Mercenary Den offers significantly improved

notes.title: Update 71
notes.content:
Lords & Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 71. The road ahead is paved with many surprises, so gather your armies and prepare to be amazed!

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]

1. Seasons Pass – a brand new limited-time progression with great rewards! Complete Daily and Weekly Challenges to earn Battle Points and conquer the milestones. A great reward will be unlocked for each milestone. Purchase the Premium Pass to get even more exclusive rewards!

2. Champion Classes Extension – the maximum Champion Classes rank has been increased to rank 8. This extension comes with new Champion Class Talents in each tree. 

3. Castle Level Extension – the maximum Castle level has been increased to 36. This extension comes with new Academy Researches in each Era (both Basic and Advanced).

4. Arctic Tiger - new March Trait Animal Companion. Has the ability to buff and de-buff Swordsmen units. It also has the ability to reduce all enemy combat healing in battle.

[b][HOLIDAY CONTENT][/b]

1. Christmas Event Shop – opens 22 December 2023 – 2 January 2024. Participate in time-limited events to gain event shop currency and use it to acquire the items you desire!

2. Festive Village Event – join forces with all the rulers in your Realm to build the most magnificent Festive Village! Upgrade your Village to spawn more crates and collect them for festive rewards! 

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]

1. World Encounters Theme Rotation – this season the Vikings will invade the Realms. Smash their camps and pillage all their treasures!

2. A new Path to Glory progression awaits with new missions and prizes!

[b][BALANCE CHANGES] [/b]

1. Animal Companions Damage Effectiveness
We are introducing a change that will affect how much damage your March Trait Animal Companions deal, specifically with Traits that directly deal damage. Each affected Animal Companion Trait is marked with a new icon that provides information about the mechanic.
Your Animal Companions will deal damage based on the number of troops in your march and the tier of those troops. Partially filled marches and lower tier troops will result in a reduction in the Animal Companion's damage. Note that this reduction is most significant after Stronghold level 30, especially for Tier 1-3 troops.

Also note that if you are using a full march of high tier units (Tiers 5 & 6), you will not see any reduction in Animal Companion damage - the animal will deal 100% of its damage, as it was prior to this update. Using the highest available tier units will always result in maximum effectiveness.
This mechanic will also affect rallies - in this case the average effectiveness of the different troop tiers in the rally will be taken into account. Note that when sending troops to a rally, the effectiveness displayed to you will not necessarily be the same when a battle actually occurs. The value shown is only an indication of your individual contribution to the rally. Also note that in Raids, effectiveness will be reduced as troops get wounded after each wave.
Check the Info pages for more details.

2. Festive Village event
Each upgrade of the Festive Village will now spawn more Festive Crates. For example, before we implemented this change, at Festive Village level 10 only 1800 Crates spawned on the map. Now at level 10, the Festive Village will spawn 3400 Crates. In addition, the Crates loot pool has been improved with more and better items.

3. Upgrading Mythic Equipment items now costs a bit more Mythic Bars

notes.title: Update 68
notes.content:
Lords and Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 68! Balance is not something you find, it’s something you create! In this update we rallied our efforts, aiming to create a better balance for most of our time-limited events and some progression systems. Without any further ado, let’s see what the future of the Realms holds.

[b][BALANCE CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS][/b]

[b]ALLIANCE RAIDS[/b]
1.	Dark Citadel
• Enemies now come in a new set of Army Formations
• New Reward Chests (including Steel and Animal Licenses)
• A new pool of Equipment Items to gain, that can be upgraded to Mythic rarity

2. Heroic Dark Citadel
• Enemies now come in a new set of Army Formations
• New Reward Chests (including Steel and Animal Licenses)
• A new Equipment Item “Argent Edge”
• Increased amount of Equipment Items rewards
• Increased Gold for the best Reward
• T6 Healing Tickets for Castles Level 35 as a Wave reward (instead of T5)
• Increased difficulty

3. The Brotherhood Assault
• Enemies now come in a new set of Army Formations and a different Battle Tactic
• Slightly increased difficulty
• New Reward Chests (T5 to T6 Upgrade Vouchers and Animal License Chest)
• Increased Gold Reward   

[b]SPY IMMUNITY[/b]
1. 2h Immunity for 20 Security Points changed to 8h Immunity for 30 Security Points
2. 8h Immunity for 60 Security Points changed to 24h for 100 Security Points
3. 24h Immunity for 100 Security Points changed to 72h for 200 Security Points

[b]BARBARIAN ASSAULT EVENT[/b]
1. Army changes:
• Army Size in Hordes slightly increased
• March Size of Barbarian Marches toward Capitals slightly increased
• March Size of Barbarian Marches toward Regional Structures increased
• The frequency of Barbarian Marches of higher-level Horde Camps towards Regional Structures slightly increased
• Slightly increased Army Attack and Health of all Horde Camps
• Slightly increased the March Speed of Barbarians, coming from Horde Camps Level 6 and 7
• Barbarian armies can now be in 2 additional Army Formations
• Barbarian Ranged Units can now shoot without moving

2. Gold Reward:
• Slightly increased the Overall Gold reward for defeating a Horde
• Slightly increased the Repulsion Gold reward for a Capital
• Slightly increased the Repulsion Gold reward for a Regional Structure
***Dev notes: The Barbarian Hordes’ changes affect only the Barbarian Assault event. They do not affect the Resistance Hordes that are spawned from an Imperial Decree.

[b]PARAGON[/b]
1. Maximum Paragon level is now 275
2. New Paragon Skill – Super Boost
• +800% to your current highest Attack or Health bonus of an Army Units type (once activated it does not change upon switching Equipment Presets)
• Duration: 20 minutes
• Cooldown: 12 hours

[b]EVENT REWARDS[/b]
***Dev notes: We are currently working on increasing and improving the Milestone and Leaderboard rewards for all existing events. Those changes will take place around 10 days after we release Update 68. The goal is to improve the balance for the acquisition of some resources that are crucial for the mid-late game progression. 
1. Paragon Experience in all Paragon events is slightly increased
2. Healing Vouchers have been added in multiple events’ Leaderboard rewards
3. Animal Food and Licenses have been added in multiple events’ Leaderboard rewards
4. Mythic Bars have been added in multiple events’ Leaderboard rewards
5. Some store-exclusive Equipment Chests have been added to the Leaderboard rewards of the Tug of War event and all Grand events (*might be added to other events’ rewards in the future)
6. Blitz events now have additional rewards for 51 – 100 place
7. Upgrade to Tier 6 Vouchers have been added to the Blitz Lottery Leaderboard Rewards, Realm Rivalry Leaderboard Rewards and Grand World Encounters Rewards
8. Milestone Rewards have been added to the History Narrative Events for each completed mission. Bonus rewards can be received if you activate the Event Pass.
9. Steel acquisition increased
• Steel received from Daily Quests Milestones from 180k to 480k
• Steel received from Traveling Hero Missions from 150k to 500k
• Steel received from Super Adventure from 100k to 600k
• Steel received from Alliance World Encounters solo progression from 1m to 10m
• Steel received from Warpath Battle of the Day Leaderboard from 300k to 1m
• Steel received from Warpath Battle of the Day Monthly Leaderboard from 5m to 20m

*Only players above a certain Castle level can receive Steel from the listed channels

[b]DISTRICT ENHANCEMENTS[/b]
1. All District Buildings now have 4 Enhancement Slots
2. New District Enhancement Items have been added
* To be unlocked a few days after the release of Update 68

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]
1. 9 new Scepter Equipment Items have been added to the game
2. Added a Fast Healing button in Atlantis
3. Event Buff for Historical Story Missions has been added – purchase this Buff to acquire 1 additional march and reduce all timers in World Map objects by 50%

[b][SEASONAL CONTENT][/b]
1. World Encounters Theme Rotation: Thieves will invade the Realms! March against their camps and pillage them to retrieve the treasures they have stolen!
2. New Path to Glory
3. New Realm Age: Age of Valor

[b][QUALITY OF LIFE][/b]
1.	Battle Report notifications now have different colors based on the outcome of the battle

notes.title: Update 63 "THE INFIRMARY"
notes.content:
Lords and Ladies, our march to greatness continues with Update 63 “The Infirmary”. This update brings to the Realms a special extension to your Temple that prevents you from losing too many troops in battle. We are also excited about the abundance of holiday content and gifts that are coming in April. Without any further ado, let’s see what the future of the Realms holds.

[NEW FEATURES]

INFIRMARY – a special extension of the Temple building that prevents you from permanently losing troops under specific battle conditions. The Infirmary is unlocked with the Temple building at Castle level 5.

notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye, my Lords and Ladies! Update 52 has marched into the Realms with a brand new Imperial Game, a bunch of great Quality of Life improvements and some sweet holiday content. Without any further ado, let’s see what the Future of the Realms holds!

[b][NEW FEATURES][/b]

1. Jousting Tourney Imperial Game

When the Realm Emperor initiates the event, a Jousting Knight Arena spawns in the middle of the Realm Map

   - Around the Jousting Knight Arena spawn 4 Jousting Knight Encounter Camps lvl 1
­   - Jousting Knight Encounter Camps can be scouted and the battles against them do not wound or kill any units (units are restored automatically after the battle)
­   - The Jousting Knight Encounter Camps are individual for each player
­   - After being defeated, each Jousting Knight Encounter Camp increases its level by 1, and thus, its difficulty (up to lvl 25 max)
­   - When players defeat a Jousting Knight Encounter Camp they receive 1 level point to upgrade their personal Jousting Knight
­   - After a Jousting Knight Encounter Camp has been defeated a cooldown is triggered and the player has to do one PvP round to reset it

notes.content:
UPDATE 46: War Never Changes 

The earth would shake with roaring rumble as the Alliance War approaches. A new era of waging war is upon us, my Lords and Ladies. Gather your Alliance forces and march on to victory!

[NEW FEATURES]

ALLIANCE WARS

- Gain Alliance War Score points by: killing or wounding enemy units at Capitals/Bastions/Seats of Power and conquering/occupying or devastating these objects

- For any Capital, Bastion or Bastion Capital [adjacent to the Bastion], the owner receives the War Score for incapacitated units immediately

- The generated War Score for the attacker is stored in the Capital and received on successful contest, along with the base score for the structure itself

- For neutral Capitals and Seats of Power, the War Score for incapacitated units is received by both sides immediately (note that no War is required to fight at the Seats of Power, but War Score could still be earned if you are fighting there with the enemy)

- Gain Personal War Score points based on your army might contribution to a Rally/Reinforcement when an Alliance battle occurs and gain a brand new Avatar Frame

- Each conquered/occupied Capital will trigger a small negative Army Offense bonus in Capital battles against the same Alliance, so don`t overstretch your ambitions

- Signing a Truce will immediately reward all eligible members of the Alliance with War Chest based on the Alliance War Score

OCCUPY A CAPITAL

- Enemy Capitals can now be “occupied” during Alliance Wars, granting the controlling Alliance a temporary, partial control of the enemy region and all its benefits (occupying enemy Capitals can bypass the general limit of 20 owned Capitals)

- After the War timer is over or the Alliances make peace, the occupied regions will return to their owners

BASTION AND CAPITAL SIEGE

- Bastion can now be attacked and defended. It can also be conquered using the same mechanics as Regional Capitals

- Bastion cannot be relocated during an Alliance War

- Bastion now requires time to be rebuilt

- Bastion now has a rebuild cooldown, which starts after initiating the process (following a de-spawn). Be wise when you decide where to place it next

- Defend your Bastion at all costs during a war, because if conquered it would allow your enemies to attack your adjacent Capital and award them a high amount of War Score points

- Only after a Bastion has been conquered the attackers can storm its adjacent Capital and trigger a series of short skirmish battles in order to conquer/ravage or occupy the Capital

- As a last chance, the defending Alliance could try to recover the conquered Bastion in order to interrupt any ongoing conquest on the adjacent Capital

WAR FAME

- At the end of each war the Alliances will be awarded with War Fame equal to their War Score

- War Fame can be used for acquiring level 4 Capital & Bastion advancements and further upgrading your Bastion level

- War Fame can also be gained by fighting armies at Capitals in foreign Realms during RvR Events

[QUALITY OF LIFE] 
- Improved Conquer Capitals Event
- Improved Alliance Encounters rewards: Solo Progression

[SEASONAL & OTHER CONTENT]
- Fight the mysterious Ronins in the new PvE season

notes.title: Update 27 Live!
notes.content:
Update 27 arrives with Santa’s sleigh and it’s full of sparkling surprises! Gem stones, new equipment bonuses, a new equipment slot and exclusive holiday features are all coming to test your imagination and ingenuity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/5639c426dcd76b18f3b16373bafe798b12d75a97.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gemstones – the evolution of crafting! [/h1]  (Live on December 7)
The crafting has just reached a new level! Evolve your Champion equipment by socketing valuable gems that grant game-changing bonuses. Discover a huge number of combinations by fusing and socketing gems of six unique types. 

•	Gemstones will be unlocked at Castle Level 15
•	Only selected equipment items will have gem sockets, those include all Epic and Legendary quality gear
•	To unlock the gem sockets, an equipment item must first be upgraded to 3 stars
•	Equipment items will have up to 3 sockets of specific, pre-determined colors 
•	When socketing gems, the color of the gem must match the color of the socket on the equipment item you’re trying to enhance
•	Any equipment item that is socketed with a gem will be placed in an entirely New Inventory, which will allow only a certain amount of Socketed Items to be placed inside. You can increase the size of the Socketed Items Inventory up to 100 by using a bunch of the new Jeweler’s Tools item
•	Keep in mind that if your Socketed Items inventory is full or you wish to recover gems you have already socketed, you can always remove gemstones from equipment by using the new Jeweler’s Tweezers item
•	You will be able to find gems in your Daily Quest chests and Stronghold chests, in rewards from Events, at the Exotic Dealer’s, and of course in our special gem offers.
•	Discover a huge amount of combinations that yield different results - test new strategies and surprise your enemies

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/666c852e5b9386cd1ffedb789aaf2933bee25e7a.jpg[/img]

The gems will have 6 colours – red, blue, yellow, green, white and prismatic. Each color will have up to 4 different shapes. Depending on their colour and shape, gems grant different bonuses to the equipment item they are socketed in. In addition, there are 6 levels of gemstones available for each color and shape. Fuse gems of the same colour and level to receive a higher level gem for increased bonuses. Mix and match until you find the most powerful combination.
Note that the Prismatic Gems are special gems that can go into any socket, regardless its colour. 

[h1] New Equipment Slot – Cloaks! [/h1] (Live on December 7)
Complete your Champion’s formidable look with a Cloak that will underscore your skills and might perfectly. Cloaks are a unique new equipment item that brings special bonuses unlike any you’ve seen before. The new bonuses scale depends on the quality of the Cloak. Some of them are Gathered Resource – gain X% additional resources based on the amount and type of resources gathered at a resource tile when the army returns to your city and Strength vs. Encounters (Stackable Effect) – Gain X% Army Attack & Health vs. Encounters for 30 minutes after defeating a PvE Encounter Camp with your Champion leading the army. This effect stacks up to 5 times. You can get also Trade Deal Modifier, Lower Enemy Attributes in Combat and others.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/07819d76462877dbed0d42b5c4ac63d24329ed32.jpg[/img]

[h1] Personal Event Milestones [/h1]
Now every player can get rewards from events upon achieving their personal milestones. King or squire – everyone counts! The personal goals will always be in the form of milestones and will grant excellent rewards for your efforts. You can expect to see the following Personal Events: Train Units, Gain Might Pillage/Recover Capitals, Burn/Loot Cities, Siege Battles and Purge Barbarians.

[h1] Festive Season in Your Realm! [/h1]
The holidays are coming to your Castle – enjoy tons of exclusive activities! Lottery: Christmas edition, new city skin – the Chateau, the always exciting Snowball Fun Events, New PvE: The Vikings and Special Winter Calendar rewards - Save the dates between 18th of December – 2nd of January and login every day to claim fantastic gifts from the calendar!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/42c8cb51b5138230ce866239800ecd0b814f394a.jpg[/img]

[h1] Other Changes & Improvements [/h1]
•	The transfer between realms of accounts that are older than 14 days is now limited - if a player has had his castle for more than two weeks, he/she won’t be able to transfer to other realms.  
•	Daily Urn cooldown is now 1 hour (down from 2 hours)
•	Daily Quests have received some tuning and should now be more appropriate depending on the player’s Castle level
•	Language menu changes
•	Path to Glory XVIII
•	Now that your strength can grow bigger with the new powerful bonuses and equipment, we’d like to notify you that the Barbarian Hordes (Events) and Resistance Camps (Purge the Realm) have adjusted their powers, too, to be better prepared when they meet you in battle. Their Attack and Health bonuses are now increased to bring them closer to their intended power level.

[h1]The Imperial Siege[/h1]
This event is played in two distinct phases. In the Build-up Phase, players can invade other realms and prepare for battle. Once the Build-up phase is over, the Siege Phase begins and players can start sending rallies against the enemy structures. Those phases are explained in details below.

[b]Build-up Phase [/b]
Squire, Knight or King – get ready for the siege and strike as one while your enemy mobilizes! Gather as many War Supplies as possible to upgrade your army, Throne and structures. Upgrade fierce Siege Towers to breach the enemy’s wall easily. Fortify the Defensive Garrisons on your home realm’s siege wall so no enemy can come through.
When the Imperial Siege event starts all players in the Throne of Might and Seats of Power areas are relocated back to their Alliance territories; all active marches are cancelled, too.
New structures are spawned in the areas of the Throne of Might and the Seats of Power (all other objects  - mines, camps, etc. are removed). These are the War Supplies Storages, the Siege Walls, the Defensive Garrisons, the Siege Towers (next to Defensive Garrisons), the Healing Tent, the Armory, and last but not least - the Rally Point 
Players can level up their Throne of Might (for defenders) and Seats of Power (for invaders) by sending War Supplies. Other structures (Healing Tent, Armory, Rally Point) cannot be upgraded to a higher level until the Throne of Might or the Seat of Power has been upgraded to that level first.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/9d0463719eba258c028e691801035a4013000351.png[/img]

[b]Siege Phase [/b]
Attack and conquer – lead your army in the most epic battles ever! Destroy all key defences of the enemy wall and breach it. Conquer the Throne of Might in the final battle and gain a huge amount of event points. Win the Imperial Siege and enjoy a colossal golden feast for your realm!
In order to destroy a Defensive Garrison, the invaders must gather troops in the respective Siege Tower. Once enough units are gathered inside, the Siege Tower will begin a countdown to start a rally.  
At the same time, the Defenders are able to reinforce that Defensive Garrison, so that they can prepare for the battle. Each time the Defensive Garrison’s army is defeated in battle, the Defensive Garrison will be damaged. Once enough damage is inflicted, the garrison will be destroyed.

After all of the Defensive Garrisons are destroyed for an Invading Realm, the players from that Realm may start a Rally from their own Rally Point towards the Throne of Might. If the Throne is successfully contested and held for the required amount of time by an Invading Realm, it is then destroyed and no other Realm or even the defenders can contest it again. This awards a large amount of event points!

[b]Emperor’s Skills[/b]
During the Build-up and Siege Phases, players will gather large amounts of War Supplies to fuel their conquest and defenses. This in turn will generate a special resource called Imperial Tokens that can be used by the Emperors of each realm to activate powerful abilities that may define the outcome in the event! Some of them have an instant effect, while others provide a timed bonus for the entire realm. Proper planning and strategic use of the Emperor’s abilities is crucial to the success of the realm!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/a1920f3fa9ec8cca382a6debf84d6e9f35053d2b.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Research Types[/h1]
Your great Academy has attracted the best scientists in the realm and they have a few new ideas. Explore and research the 6 new technologies that have been added to Era VI to gain an edge against your foes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/b5fb0fddbe925b6e38f71bd6171dac4be26f7e02.jpg[/img]

[h1]New PvE: The Savages[/h1]
Outsmart the Savages in a series of tactical battles. Face increasingly strong enemy and destroy its every camp on your way to loot exclusive equipment for your Champion.

notes.title: Update 24 Live!
notes.content:
This summer is going to be eventful with the hot new features of Update 24! Unique stories, challenges and arduous quests await to be explored and untangled with the Narrative Journal Missions and the Hall of Fame Feats. Are you ready to put your valor and persistence to the test? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/dabff98de66b7020d05181c332cd1f327e82f7c3.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Narrative Journal Missions  [/h1]
There have been rumors among the country folk that your realm has been collapsing under attacks of unknown foe. Holly, the tavern keeper’s daughter, is the only one brave enough to come and tell you about the atrocities that your people are facing. Are you curious to know how this story goes on? 
The Narrative Journal Missions will be a time-limited story which will be available for 24 hours. It will present the players with a 5-step progression with a different mission at each step (explore, search, siege, prepare and raid) and a challenging finale. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/328a324647e564c329bf68a30288ac194689c1e6.jpg[/img]

Each of the missions includes sending a march to an unseen before object on the World Map. Completing a mission will lead to the next one, and completing the final 5th mission will complete the entire story. The completion of each mission from Step 1 to Step 4, provides a passive bonus that you can use to successfully complete Step 5 Mission, i.e. the whole story. The bonus could be for example “Skip one or two battle waves”, “Remove enemy bonuses”, “Remove enemy Units Skills”, etc. 
At the end of the day, the history remembers the victors so complete all the missions successfully and be heaped with tons of rewards!

[h1]Hall of Fame  [/h1]
“Augustus carnifex venator” – no, that’s not a Latin proverb, my Lords…These are names of the new feats you can now unlock and carve your name with golden letters in the Hall of Fame. Be the top-lord in your kingdom and earn the respect of the whole realm by letting your feats speak for you. You will be bestowed with unique medals for your achievements, and with terrific gifts. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/6aea1f5d9763ac1eebea77b849e1d9cf528ea4ce.jpg[/img]

Players will compete for three types of medals – Heroic, Seasonal and Personal Feats. All medals earned by a player will be visible for everyone in the Player Profile and/or in the Kingdom menu 

[list]
[*][u]Heroic Feats (Kingdom Menu) [/u]
The Heroic Feats are first-time achievements for a Realm and they can be earned only once. Each unlocked Heroic Feat will award a badge and an additional reward at the end of the Season. There are 5 heroic feats: Augustus (getting the Augustus Heroic Feats awards a unique city skin – the Formidable Throne);  Carnifex, Venator, Victor, Aquilifer. 
[*][u]Seasonal Feats (Kingdom Menu)[/u]
Claiming all Heroic Feats on a Realm will unlock the Seasonal Feats, however keep in mind that a season may not be currently active at that time. Feat Seasons will be much longer than regular events and will begin and end at the same time on all Realms. Each feat will have a Leaderboard, which will track the progress of the players during the Season (similar to the event ones).
[*][u]Personal Feats (Player Profile)[/u]
The Personal Feats are repeatable objectives which you can find in the Player Profile. From Signifer (Train Units) to Praetorian (Incapacitate Enemies) and Conquistador (Win Atlantis), there are over 20 types of personal feats you can now explore and work towards to claim their badges.
Note that a player can have multiple amount of the same badge.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/42f78d15f1a020ecfcd57a58932041fbc0155e18.jpg[/img]
[h1]New PVE – Thieves Camps (available on July 29, 01:00 GMT) [/h1]
Deploy your brute force and push the thieves back. Plan the attack together with your allies, loots the hideouts and collect their stolen treasures. 

[h1] QoL  [/h1]
•	Beat the New Path To Glory challenges
•	Remodel your city with the beautiful new skins 
•	New seasonal surprises in the lottery and the calendar.

notes.title: Update 23 Live!
notes.content:
Update 23 has arrived and it brings a new Cross Realm event and a Realm Chronicles section for you to carve your name into history! Also, а long awaited feature has debuted – a brand new equipment slot for your Champion, while the special Football events are back in the spotlight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/9b050e759adf55cf11708e79bbaa34fcbe2ec3d5.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Cross Realm Event: Artefact Wars – Let the Ultimate Treasure Hunt Begin![/h1] 
Brave rulers from different realms will clash in a merciless fight to find and collect all the Artefacts! Work together as a Realm and outsmart your foreign opponents to find and steal their Artefacts before they do. You will need both good strategy and luck to succeed. Control all the Artefacts until the end of the foreign invasion and massive rewards will spawn in your lands! Artefact Wars will have two phases: Preparation and Invasion phase. 
Also, during the Artefacts Wars there will be Alliance event that counts the invading units killed (Similar to Cross-Realm Kill Event, but only for invader units).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/88e10a36094f719cbb9e320c1490a40f17b25514.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Trinket Equipment - More bonuses for your champion, more might![/h1]  (Unlocked on June 18, around 12:00 GMT) 
Ancient charms, steel talismans, Barbarian necklaces, wisdom trinkets, and many more unique jewels and statuettes can now be obtained and crafted for your Champion to wear in battle. Besides the good luck they bring, they will also unleash powerful effects on you and your opponents. So adorn your hero’s armory and enjoy brand new skill boosts. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/ce668e3d839b23f15a094afd68eae8a42f744c2c.jpg[/img]

[h1] Realm Chronicles – Your Heroic Deeds Are Now Part of the Realm Chronicles! [/h1] (Unlocked on June 18, around 12:00 GMT)
Become part of the Realm history and let everyone know about your heroic deeds! Get informed about all the meaningful and impactful events in your lands by a special broadcast in the Global and Alliance chat. Develop the lore your Realm needs and have those lessons you learnt the hard way scripted down on the pages of your Kingdom! 
The Realm Chronicles will be written in the Chronicles Menu. It will contain daily and weekly logs. Every log entry will be broadcast in the World and Alliance chats as a system message with its own Realm Avatar and color. 

[h1] Join the Realm Golden Cup Rush![/h1] 
[list]
[*]New PvE Encounters: Challengers – Do you dare challenge the professionals in medieval football? Train your army and enter the arena. The winner takes it all – an exclusive equipment chest! (Unlocked on June 17, around 01:00 GMT)
[*]Special Football Events – Exclusive Football events will take over the realm. Clash with enemy alliances to become the champion team of your kingdom. We will announce a few days in advance on our Facebook page and in-game about the starting time and schedule of the events.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/a1ac6b7582c21fe36b9bf070d26413e885a15f1d.jpg[/img]

[h1] QoL[/h1] 
[list]
[*]You can now enjoy better and smoother visuals especially on the Map view with the new option to switch to 60 FPS. Simply go to the Options menu and try it out.                  
[*]The War Rallies policy and Fearless Marches decree will no longer apply their effects during Realm vs. Realm events
[*]Trading post tokens – from now on, there will be a number of trading marches tokens available to the player and each time he sends a trading march the number of tokens will be reduced by one. There will be a trading march token generation timer that will give an extra trading march token every 30 minutes (until a certain maximum is reached) (unlocked on June 18, around 12:00 GMT)
[*]The Player’s VIP level will be visible in his/her Profile and in the chat
[*]New Path to Glory unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: Update 22 Live!
notes.content:
Update 22 is here and it’s promising legendary times ahead! A travelling hero arrives in your castle, 5 new Champion levels unlock unique sets of talents, 3 new spy missions and 5 more VIP levels give game-changing bonuses and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/98ffe50c74bc4507afca3d716fe46ebedaf49dc6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Travelling Hero Missions (Available on April 30t h at 12:00 GMT)[/h1]
A weary traveller will soon dock his ship in your city to ask for help (in player Castles above lv. 7). There are many injustices that plague the land and he needs your aid to help the people. If you manage to complete his missions successfully, you will earn a chest with unique gear. This will increase your reputation level as well. The higher the reputation level, the better the chest you will receive. 

[h1]Get Even Sneakier With The New Spy Missions! (Available on April 30t h at 12:00 GMT)[/h1]
Your Spies can now reach Level 15 and have even better chance to succeed in mission. More importantly, at level 13 each spy can unlock a new mission type: Wound a Spy (Assassin), Sabotage Logistics (Saboteur) and Expose Weakness (Infiltrator). Head to the Dungeon on April 30th and discover all about them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/ce922f541887190eb35b223c8a1ae8d40a9dfdc6.jpg[/img]

[h1]New VIP Levels (Available on April 30t h at 12:00 GMT)[/h1]
Climb the ladder of the 4 new VIP levels and leave your opponents in the dust. They provide increased bonuses. Also, several unique new VIP bonuses have been added, including bonus Paragon Points, Spy Security increase and a Rally Health bonus for each army that joins it.

[h1]New Champion Levels (Available on April 30t h at 12:00 GMT)[/h1]
Reach Champion level 75 and stand tall above your enemies. Explore the new talents of your Champion that have been added to each talent tree for even more powerful bonuses. Go ahead and try out the new recipes for legendary equipment

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/6e1409d4fa0e08258f1f53ec2d031c3367386c3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Brand New PvE camps – the Ronin Wildlands (Available on April 29t h at 01:00 GMT)[/h1]
The Samurai have travelled a long way from the East to debut in your realm with their sharp naginatas! Don’t let them turn your lands into wildlands - team up with your allies and plan your strategy to stop their invasion and loot uniquely themed equipment. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/d2a38f0218de320b948cf521952ecd4263bd2955.jpg[/img]

[h1]Celebrate the Golden Week[/h1]
Get ready for the Special Relic Hunt event – go on the hunt for the antique relics and claim your rewards in gold during this exclusive event. Be on the lookout for more info in our in-game news section and our Facebook page about the precise date of the event. Also Exclusive Calendar rewards will be available from April 28th to May 6th and a lottery: Golden Week Edition (available from April 28 until May 22, 2018)

[h1]More cool stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invite a Friend option – Invite all your buddies to the game – the more the merrier. Receive valuable rewards when they reach progress milestone. And your friends will also receive a special chest for the achievement. To invite someone, head to “Options” and select “Invite a Friend”. (The feature will be available shortly after the Update - be on the lookout for more info in our in-game news section and our Facebook page about the precise date)
[*] Compete for the shiny new set of exclusive Emperor gear
[*] Regional Capitals reinforcement size will be 4.4 mln as of April 30th
[*] Allow the rally leader to remove rally participants from rally
[*] The next Path to Glory is unlocked
[*] Minor improvements and bug fixes
[*] We fixed an issue where Barbarians Hordes and Resistance Bases did not use their full force when battling players which made them an easier enemy to defeat. 
[/list]

notes.content:
Greetings, my Lords,
Prepare for a bigger, better and bolder Update 21! This time, the Leprechaun has fulfilled more than 3 wishes of yours – a new Stronghold level, new research era, different faction units, crafting improvements and an Atlantis event for castles level 15 and above. And there’s even more…so read on to find out!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/526981c0f4bde1609def4906d656301d8170cef0.jpg[/img]

[h1] Stronghold Level 31 – break the limits and grow bigger![/h1]
Push your limits by advancing to the new max level of your stronghold. It will unlock a new research era for major gameplay improvements, a new class of faction units and a new battle formation that will open additional strategic options in combat.
[list]
[*]New Research Era VI – it will be unlocked with 40 new research levels. 
[*]A New Class of Powerful Faction Units - Depending on the faction you have selected, you will be able to train different new faction units – each with unique skills that can impact the battle: Yeoman Archers (Kings), Mamluks (Sultans) and Varangians (Tsars).
[*]Bigger marches and rally size - Edge out your opponents with increased march and rally size of your army. Besides, you can train more units and heal faster.
[*]All buildings can reach Level 31 – Take the huge advantage from the boosted stats of all city buildings. 
[*]New Battle Formation – Find counters to existing strategies and see how this new formation fits into the meta.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/3f5f88d16e3027cb0336a5dbe2c6dc2872fa6d23.jpg[/img]

[h1] Atlantis Is More Inviting Than Ever! [/h1] 
Welcome on board, my Lords! Atlantis is now open for anyone level 15 and above! That is if you dare to join the massive army clash, of course. Discover the revamped Atlantis Island and join the deeper and richer world where the survival is the only option. Also - you can now enjoy a streamlined and polished Atlantean experience with new Atlantis Tasks, Spoils of War and Attack Cooldown.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/d9450dea798a9db7238893a6118a999dd8ab13ea.jpg[/img]

[h1] Enhanced Guardian Feature[/h1] 
Increase your Guardian Level and unlock powerful PvE bonuses! Keep collecting Guardian points and they will get you closer to the new shiny Guardian Chest.

[h1] Spring Forward to the New Seasonal Treats![/h1] 
[list]
[*]New PvE camps – The Defilers Return! Spring to arms and completely ruin their temples to collect powerful new equipment for your champion. (Available on March 18th, 01:00 GMT)
[*]Special Easter Calendar – Be smart and login every day as alluring treasures
[*]Lottery: Spring Edition – A new vernal look of the lottery is coming up with refreshed arsenal of rewards!
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/948c54a9945c6f6feff66145ae0af66ac2da33e5.jpg[/img]

[h1] Quality of life Improvements[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Equipment and Crafting improvements – stay organized with hundreds of gear pieces by the new search and filter functions. 
[*]VIP menu rework
[*]City skins menu redesign
[*]Event rule books – learn more about your favorite events in the new rule books available in the game 
[*]Mentoring system improvements 
[*]New Path to Glory 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 20 Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, my Lords, 

Update 20 is here and it is the best update to start the new 2018! We are introducing a Mentoring Program for all studious and super ambitious warriors out there, a new Realm Rivalry event –– for all those who thrive when they vie, plus a lot of other glorious new features that will help you outshine the competition! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/c63fb733fb0a78a19b5252378cff253b3179e8d8.png[/img]

[h1]Mentoring Program – Scientia est Potentia![/h1] 
Give 2018 a head-start with our new Mentoring Program - learn the ropes of the game straight from the proven masters! Or mentor the young leaders in your realm and pay your wisdom forward – it will earn you both fame and riches!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/b5174d16cb863fb50c048aa9a4d2fd0c8ee74fb7.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Event – Realm Rivalry![/h1] 
Join the rival clash arena, my Lords and pledge your allegiance to one of the two rival teams - the Golden Coats or the Dark Capes. 
Two large Fortresses will spawn at the start of the Event – a golden one and a dark one. All players in a realm will be split in two rival teams - a background color under the Castle’s level on the World map will define which rival team the player belongs to. A Medieval road will connect the two Fortresses and a Battering Ram will be placed in the middle of the Road.  Rebel Forces will be protecting the Battering Ram and players will have to defeat them to score points and reach event’s milestones to be able to push the Ram towards the enemy Fortress.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/e58dc8d4fd99e63473736b07a89efc9b6622f54e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Daily Urn Revamped[/h1] 
Play more and get more rewards! Come back to the game often and collect your daily urns, full of surprises. Collect five consecutive urns before the time runs out to unlock the final, extra big prize.

[h1]New Alliance Tasks[/h1]  (Available on 5th of February around 12:00 GMT) 
Build stronger relationships and demand maximum commitment from all members of your alliance with seven new alliance tasks. Achieve the goals of your alliance and reap glory and respect!                               

[h1]New PVE – Amazons are coming back![/h1]  
(Available on February 4th, 01:00 GMT)
Team up with your allies and challenge the brave daughters of Ares in a thrilling series of PvE events. Face the charming, but brutal enemy and compete for exclusive Champion equipment sealed with a kiss.   

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195434/fa31b911622ecc41254785da55cefa4d22d9effb.jpg[/img]                      

[h1]New Alliance Flags[/h1]  (Available on 5th of February around 12:00 GMT) 
New year, new look! Stand out from the crowd with the new options for your alliance flag customization! Choose from a huge selection of various elements, including national flags, heraldic symbols, gradients and patterns. You will be able to unlock the new elements and colors in exchange of homage. The new currency will be available in bundles and as an event leaderboard reward, so be on the lookout for our special offers and activities.
